information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits only analysis. The final call consumes that analysis, directly receives task, anchor_policy, anchor_contract, and task_constraints, remains cut off from candidate_hypothesis and loop_structure, and emits one complete policy.
name: Selective Inherited-Artifact Reentry
organization: two-call sequential lineage with one restored inherited-policy visibility edge

calls.objective: Reconcile inherited and counter-generative claims against normative obligations, preserve material conflicts and distinctions, and emit only analysis.

Consume synthesize_cut_counter_sources, reconcile its evidence with visible normative inputs and the directly visible inherited policy artifact, and emit one complete policy without reacquiring the other cut sources.
